name: session-skills
description: Five conversation skills: handoff writes a checked prompt for a new session, session-summary recaps this chat, braindump plays back a brain dump, explain-simply re-explains in plain bullets, and unslop removes machine-written patterns from text.

interface.shortDescription: Handoffs, chat recaps, playbacks, simpler explanations, and cleaner writing.
interface.longDescription: Five skills for the conversation itself. handoff updates the active work item and current focus, then writes a prompt a fresh session can start from and has it checked. session-summary shows what the owner asked for in this chat and where each request landed. braindump plays back a loose brain dump in simple words before any work starts. explain-simply re-explains the last answer as short plain bullets. unslop rewrites text so it no longer reads as machine-written, keeping every fact.
